pages.title: Wordsmith Books — Local Independent Bookshop
pages.html:
📚 Wordsmith Books

Wordsmith Books

Discover your next favorite story at our independent bookshop in Riverside

Featured Books This Month

The Midnight Library

by Matt Haig

A dazzling novel about all the choices that go into a life well lived. Nora Seed finds herself in a magical library between life and death, where each book lets her explore the paths she didn't take.

$18.99

Lessons in Chemistry

by Bonnie Garmus

Set in the 1960s, this novel follows Elizabeth Zott, a female chemist denied her rightful place in the lab who becomes the unlikely host of a cooking show that changes everything.

$19.99

The House in the Cerulean Sea

by TJ Klune

A magical sanctuary for dangerous magical beings is in danger of closure. Linus Baker, a by-the-book caseworker, is sent to investigate, only to find his heart opened by the found family living there.

$17.99

Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow

by Charles Yu

A sweeping epic about two friends and one woman who meet in the 1990s and spend decades creating video games that shape their lives and careers in unexpected ways.

$20.99
